book.title: Shilǝn ki Lya a toh ɗǝ Malkus

content: Kushti ki Yesu tǝn Bwasti kutletti
I Yesu hilya ɗǝlǝbi, illǝ ge' Atl ki Yehudiya, ne' tǝn bigasi ki dlǝlka Uldun. I hwu' mbalǝn maga ma'ti ɗaɗanu, i'kulcisi kan u nǝ'kuɗa u.
I palisiyawayen mbǝ ma'ti gaki sǝccimbǝlti, is ngemti is ultisu, “Kizoɗa tǝ yakǝn mbalǝn la' kǝli wasa?”
Inndǝgisi i'usu, “Ya Musa pikini?”
Is usu, “Musa bǝl mbalǝn sǝllash lwabbatki tlot kutleti, ala kǝliyisi.”
Yesu ulsisu, “Gaki ndǝlki gawakǝn lakiɗa i Musa lacikin zhiluɗa.
Amma teɗi ‘Lya kǝnǝnsi, mwani nǝ kǝli.
Gaki nǝgu a mulǝn za'dyawasi nǝ bwasi, an ngap kǝliwasi.’
Nǝguni si lopi as dǝm dlinǝm. Akinaki nǝmkǝni sǝkǝn dǝmti dli lopkǝnwai.
Ulnǝ Lya a mani u, bǝ mbalǝn bwasiwai.”
A gip libine i milkushtiwas ngemti ɗaɗanu tǝn shilǝngu.
I' ulsisu, “Mulnǝ ala kǝliwasu, in ngau kundu u, ko'kǝn ti pǝlti nǝki lopi.
In kǝliyi ala mwani wasu in ngau kundu u, tapǝl kontu ɓalu.”
Yesu Alaki mil Albalka
Mbalǝn ɗǝ mbǝllit Yesu na' mil gaki tǝttǝnsiɗa, i milkushtiwas matisi.
Nǝ Yesu yeni nǝgu u i uli cillo'si. I' ulsisu “Zakǝn na'mil sǝmmbǝ makkǝni, bi hanesiwai. Gu'ki Lya ki unduwasǝnkǝni.
Ami dlǝmikkini, mus mulnǝ andǝ nǝ gukki Lya kǝnǝ gunǝ na yakǝn ɗǝpǝlti wai u, tǝkǝn teti ge'guntiwai.”
I Yesu kansi twadli, ati zissito, ati laki'si albalka.
Yakǝn giɗǝnsi mul usǝn
Nǝ Yesu gollǝtu, i mulǝn pe'tetnǝkitǝl, inngus kinaɗakka, in ngemti i'ultisu, “Mullashti mul zo'mbadlǝ, yakǝntapǝli tambi dlǝwu nǝbǝ kǝnpa'twai u?”
I Yesu ultisu, “Yalakiɗa i'mbeki zo'mbadlǝ? Mul zo'mbatl nǝnɗawai sai Lya nǝgwasi.
Man zhilgi, ‘bǝtlo mbalǝnwai. Bǝ pǝl kontwai. Bǝ mǝgǝlwai, bǝdlǝm laga' tǝn mulǝnwai, bǝ dlu mbalǝnwai. Nal mikzǝ'ki.’ ”
I'ultisu, “Mullashti, mus apǝl undigi a ami na yakǝn.”
I Yesu yati ya'ki lyamti, i'ultisu, “Ul nǝmkǝn ɓaliki lǝ ki'ul ulnǝ ni'zi u taka, a'bǝl mingi nǝbǝ ulǝn nisi ɗawai u, kǝn mbi lǝɓa a Lya. Apa a'mbǝ a'bǝlǝnkal.”
Nǝ kub shilǝni i kinawasnda, izzǝga ati du mbadlǝ, gaki usǝn nǝdɗa eye.
A lǝbi I Yesu ya milkushtiwasi, i'ulsisu, “Nǝn lotiɗa tǝmi' usǝn tege'gu'ki Lya!”
Milkushti yi kum gagashit ki shilǝnwasi. I Yesu ulsisu ɗaɗanu, “Kini milini, nǝn lotiɗa te'ge guki Lya!
Nǝte'kǝ mul usǝn ge'guki Lya, nǝn ngǝtlǝ' tǝ lakumi tǝbɓeu ge'shuki allula.”
Is kum gagashit mulndǝlti, is ultisu, “In nǝgu uɓo, wokǝn mbi pekkǝlkǝn ngu?”
I Yesu yasi, i'usu, “Ma'mbalǝnɓo mulpǝkkǝnwai, ama bǝ ma'Lya wai. Gaki muslǝɓa mulpǝkǝni ma' Lya.”
I Bitlus ultisu, “Mi ngu ma za'lǝɓayi mabǝlkikali.”
Yesu usu, “Bali ami dlǝmi'kini, mulǝn kǝn za'ti libi, ko yelsǝniwas mudlǝ, ko yelsǝniwas mwani, ko dyawasi, ko bwasi, ko milwasi, ko guwasi, gayini nǝkuma shilǝnki Lya,

apa a'hwol mbi' diɓǝl lǝɓa kutlkutl lǝbi kutl ge' dǝpki nǝguni, nǝ libi, nǝ yelsǝni mudlǝ, nǝ yelsǝni mwani, ne' mi'zǝtti mudlǝ, ne'mil, ne'guh, i ngu kuma nǝ bǝna. A lahila ne, ammbi dliwunǝbǝ kǝn pa'twai u.
Diɓǝli kǝkina nǝnpaltikali, kikali nǝnpalti kina.”
Yesu a Dlim Undi Mǝshtu nǝ Tǝppǝli u Ɗaɗanu
Si to'ulshelima, Yesu ɗǝ lǝ'akinaɗasi, a milkushtiwas ɗǝ kup gagashinti, mbalǝnyi nǝ ɗǝ bǝdl si kalu sima asi kupɓanti. Im mbǝ' kutl nǝ lopiy, amalgǝni i'go'dlimissi ulnǝ tǝ mbitu.
I' usu, “I ngu mi sutin Ulshelima, sǝn bǝdl yakǝnmbalǝn ma'bas lǝɓasi ki Lya ne'mi'lashti zhil ki Musa, sin pocitti shilǝnki mǝshti, as bǝl mingi nǝbǝs man Lya wai u.
Sin lakkitti bi, as bezze'makǝn, as li'ti, as tloti, kalki mutti maki kuma atli lya.”
Ngepki Yakubu nǝ Yahaya
Yakubu nǝ Yahaya, milki Zabadi, is sha'temma'ti, is ultisu, “Mullashti, mingepki ki pǝlimi ulǝn.”
I ulsisu, “Yaki lyamtini ta pǝlikini?”
Is ultisu, “Ndǝgimi, cinkǝ te'ge' naltwagi, tǝ nǝm dǝm tǝn toshimtwagi, nǝm tǝn tonawagi.”
I Yesu ulsisu, “Kimanǝn ulnǝ ngemtini uwai. Kǝn ma'tleti ge'mbǝga malunǝtta tlewa? Ko nǝn ma'pǝlikkin baptisma unǝssǝ' pǝlitǝnwa?”
Is ultisu, “Mǝn manti.” I Yesu ulsisu, “Mbǝgamalunǝ tatle nǝnali u, nǝnali ki tleni, baptisma u nǝsǝ'pǝli u, nǝnali sǝppǝli kini.
Ama dǝptǝn toh shimtini, ko tǝn tohna yini, gikǝnwai gunǝ nǝ halta bǝli u. Ai, kǝginǝs pǝli gawasǝn uni.”
Nǝ milkushtiwas kutli kumi nǝgu u, is gob kub dutu'ki Yakubu nǝ Yahaya.
I Yesu takisibi i'ulsisu, “Ki manini ginǝ mansi nǝ bǝ Yahudawawai u gumsisi wasǝn sǝnɗǝ nu ne' mbalǝnwasǝn kǝmti sǝnɗǝ pǝlisi ndǝlti.
Kǝndǝmti nǝgu ge' dlomwakǝnwai, amma mulnǝ ɗǝ lyamti tǝ'dǝm bali age' kini u, sainǝ tadǝm zheli wakǝn.
Mulnǝ ɗǝlyab dǝb mulkina wakǝn u, sainǝ tadǝm zheli ki kowonngi.
Gaki yakǝn mbalǝn ma tǝ mbǝni sǝppǝli'bǝna ɗawai, gaki tima tǝppǝl bǝnaɗani, abbǝl dlǝwasi gaki diɓǝl mbalǝn.”
Yesu Ndokǝl Baltimawus Dwa u
Is mbǝkǝci a Yaliko. Ti pe'ti ɗǝ Yaliko ngu, nǝti ne'mikkushtiwasi, nǝ bal dwobgakǝ diɓǝl mbalǝn, i dwa won mul ngeplu shinwasi Baltimawus, yakǝnki Timawus, tiki dǝmi a bishitu.
Nǝkkumi Yesu mul Nazalat kǝn u, i'go' tlǝl yali ati usu, “Yesu yakǝnki Dauda, kum gontini!”
I diɓǝl mbalǝn matiti, tǝn bǝshilǝnnuwai. Amma i'gob mbǝtl tlǝl yaltinki, ti usu, “yakǝnki Dauda kum gontini!”
I Yesu dlili i'usu, “Takitibi teh.” Is taki dwanisi bi teɗi is ultisu, “Albishiliwagi! Leteɗi, ti mbekkibi.”
Illa' ul idlatti taka, ittlǝtyama' Yesu.
I Yesu ultisu, “Yaki lyamti ta pǝliki?” Idwani ultisu, “mullashti, tambi yellu!”
I Yesu ultisu, “Zǝgawagi, la'ti mbalwa' a ndokǝlki.” Alǝbi i'ellu, ibbǝl Yesu kal izzǝga.
